title: Mixed Custom Exam Written Question Bank

markscheme: M1: correct column-subtraction method with exchanging shown or implied
questions.modelAnswer: Align the digits by place value. Subtracting the ones requires exchanging a ten, and subtracting the tens requires exchanging a hundred. $724 - 358 = 366$. Check: $366 + 358 = 724$.
Partition $24$ into $20 + 4$. Then $36 \times 20 = 720$ and $36 \times 4 = 144$. Add the partial products: $720 + 144 = 864$.
Collect like terms: $4a - a = 3a$ and $2b + 5b = 7b$. The simplified expression is $3a + 7b$.
Multiply both terms inside the brackets by $3$: $3 \times 2x = 6x$ and $3 \times (-5) = -15$. Therefore $3(2x - 5) = 6x - 15$.

questions.stem: A rectangle measures $11$ cm by $5$ cm. Work out its area.
questions.modelAnswer: The area of a rectangle is length multiplied by width. $11 \times 5 = 55$, so the area is $55\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.stem: A triangle has base $10$ cm and perpendicular height $6$ cm. Work out its area.
questions.modelAnswer: Use the triangle area formula $A = \dfrac{1}{2}bh$. Substituting gives $\dfrac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 6 = 30$, so the area is $30\text{ cm}^2$.

markscheme: M1: $5x = 20$ after subtracting $4$ from both sides
questions.modelAnswer: Subtract $4$ from both sides to obtain $5x = 20$. Divide both sides by $5$, giving $x = 4$. Check: $5 \times 4 + 4 = 24$.

markscheme: M1: $\dfrac{x}{3} = 7$ after subtracting $2$ from both sides
questions.modelAnswer: Subtract $2$ from both sides: $\dfrac{x}{3} = 7$. Multiply both sides by $3$ to obtain $x = 21$. Check: $21 \div 3 + 2 = 9$.

questions.stem: Two angles on a straight line are $47^\circ$ and $x$. Work out $x$.
questions.modelAnswer: Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$. Therefore $x = 180^\circ - 47^\circ = 133^\circ$. The two angles sum to $180^\circ$.

questions.stem: The angles of a quadrilateral are $80^\circ$, $95^\circ$, $110^\circ$ and $x$. Work out $x$.
questions.modelAnswer: The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360^\circ$. The three known angles total $285^\circ$, so $x = 360^\circ - 285^\circ = 75^\circ$.

questions.stem: Work out $\dfrac{2}{3} + \dfrac{1}{6}$. Give your answer in its simplest form.
markscheme: M1: common denominator of $6$ used to obtain $\dfrac{4}{6} + \dfrac{1}{6}$
questions.modelAnswer: Write $\dfrac{2}{3}$ as $\dfrac{4}{6}$. Then $\dfrac{4}{6} + \dfrac{1}{6} = \dfrac{5}{6}$, which is already in its simplest form.

questions.stem: Work out $\dfrac{5}{6} - \dfrac{1}{4}$. Give your answer in its simplest form.
markscheme: M1: common denominator of $12$ used to obtain $\dfrac{10}{12} - \dfrac{3}{12}$
questions.modelAnswer: The lowest common denominator is $12$. Convert to $\dfrac{10}{12} - \dfrac{3}{12}$, then subtract the numerators to get $\dfrac{7}{12}$.

questions.stem: A sequence begins $3, 8, 13, 18, \ldots$ Find the $30$th term.
markscheme: M1: common difference $5$ identified and used to build an nth-term rule
questions.modelAnswer: The common difference is $5$, so the rule starts $5n$. The first term is $3$, and $5(1) - 2 = 3$, giving nth term $= 5n - 2$. For $n = 30$: $5(30) - 2 = 148$.

questions.stem: A sequence begins $20, 16, 12, 8, \ldots$ Find the $15$th term.
markscheme: M1: common difference $-4$ identified and used to build an nth-term rule
questions.modelAnswer: The terms decrease by $4$, so the rule contains $-4n$. Since the first term is $20$, the rule is $24 - 4n$. For $n = 15$: $24 - 4(15) = 24 - 60 = -36$.

markscheme: M1: multiplier $1.35$ used, or $35\%$ of $80 = 28$ found
questions.modelAnswer: An increase of $35\%$ corresponds to the multiplier $1.35$. Calculate $80 \times 1.35 = 108$. Equivalently, add the increase of $28$ to the original $80$.

questions.stem: After a $10\%$ price increase, a game costs £66. Work out its original price.
markscheme: M1: recognises that £66 is $110\%$ of the original and divides by $1.10$
questions.modelAnswer: The increased price is $110\%$ of the original price. Divide £66 by $1.10$ to find $100\%$: $66 \div 1.10 = 60$. The original price was £60.
